{
  "project_id": "P-MNG-ThirdEnergySector",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Electricity tariffs set below the cost of service create severe sector financial deficits and reliance on subsidies, threatening power sector utility viability.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Support tariff reform strategies and analytical studies on utility financial viability during project implementation.",
      "evidence": "The current electricity price is below the cost of service causing financial difficulties for sector utilities."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Transmission capacity constraints on the single-circuit 220kV Baganuur-Choir corridor prevent evacuation of existing renewable power and block new renewable connections.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Construct a new 220kV double-circuit transmission line from Baganuur to Choir Substation and expand associated substations.",
      "evidence": "its output is constrained due to the limit of the transmission capacity of the Baganuur-Choir 220kV single-circuit line"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "An aging coal-fired CHP generation fleet lacks operational flexibility, hindering system dispatch and integration of variable renewable energy.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Strengthen grid infrastructure, deploy battery energy storage systems, and provide technical assistance for variable renewable energy integration.",
      "evidence": "The CHP plants make the power system inflexible, making it indispatchable and difficult to integrate Variable Renewable Energy"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Construction and operation of overhead high-voltage transmission lines present collision hazards and habitat disturbance for local bird populations.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Realign the transmission line routing to avoid wetland habitats, install bird flight diverters, and implement a Bird Management Plan.",
      "evidence": "Transmission lines in Mongolia often involve bird collision and other biodiversity issues"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "A newly established PMO lacking experience with World Bank fiduciary and operational procedures creates risks of implementation delays.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Hire an Owner's Engineer to assist the PMO and conduct early World Bank training on procurement, financial management, and safeguards.",
      "evidence": "Previous infrastructure projects in Mongolia have experienced implementation delays due to the administrative and technical capacity constraints of the implementing agencies."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "The short local construction season in Mongolia means civil works delays prior to winter can postpone project completion by an entire year.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Initiate advance procurement planning to begin works early in the season and use rated criteria evaluating contractors' short-season delivery plans.",
      "evidence": "If it cannot be completed before winter, the Project will have more delays with waiting for the next construction season."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Heavy dependence on imported construction materials and lack of domestic suppliers for 220kV components expose the project to supply chain delays.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Utilize international competitive bidding, conduct supply market intelligence, and actively monitor material procurement lead times.",
      "evidence": "The construction sector in Mongolia has been heavily reliant on imports, with statistics showing that 75-80% of construction materials are sourced from outside the country."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Extreme climate hazards including severe cold, heavy snow, freezing, high winds, and flooding pose risks of structural damage to transmission lines.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate resilient engineering design standards for towers and insulators considering maximum wind loads, extreme cold, and flood risks.",
      "evidence": "Mongolia is prone to risks from climate hazards such as flooding, wildfires, and landslides, with exposure to drought and extreme cold"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Workers face severe occupational health and safety hazards during civil works, including electrocution, falling from height, and tower collapse risks.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Enforce Labor Management Procedures, adopt World Bank Group EHS Guidelines, and implement mandatory high-altitude and live-line safety protocols.",
      "evidence": "occupational health and safety (OHS) risks associated with live power lines, working at height, electric and magnetic fields (EMF)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Gender-based workplace biases and obstacles constrain women's employment and career advancement in technical and managerial roles at the transmission utility.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 2,
      "mitigation": "Conduct a workforce gender gap assessment, adopt gender-responsive HR policies, provide female leadership training, and track gender target indicators.",
      "evidence": "gender-based biases may be an obstacle to women’s employment and especially to career progression at NPTG."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Civil works during line construction may cause temporary restrictions on access to pastureland, wells, and resources for local herder communities.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement the Resettlement Policy Framework and Stakeholder Engagement Plan, conducting consultations and utilizing the project Grievance Redress Mechanism.",
      "evidence": "temporary restriction of access to resources by local herders (for example, pasture, wells, etc.) and sensitive receptors"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Evaluation Committee members' unfamiliarity with English bidding documents and World Bank procurement regulations risks delays in contract awards.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide targeted World Bank procurement training to Evaluation Committee staff and establish clear decision-making workflows in the POM.",
      "evidence": "The Evaluation Committee members normally do not have knowledge and experience in handling English documents, and it may cause delays with the evaluation process."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "High prevalence of unqualified construction materials in the local market risks compromising the quality and safety of transmission infrastructure.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Apply rated evaluation criteria to assess bidders' material quality control strategies and mandate strict material testing protocols.",
      "evidence": "40% of construction materials were found unqualified in the local market."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Government election cycles and frequent turnover of decision-making officials risk disrupting PMO staffing continuity and delaying key approvals.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Proactively engage re-elected or new government officials, formalize PMO staffing decrees, and institutionalize project implementation arrangements.",
      "evidence": "Potential changes in Government officials involved in project activities due to election cycle in first half year of next calendar year"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Lack of transmission line redundancy on key power corridors leads to prolonged electricity supply outages and high network fault vulnerability.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Construct a double-circuit 220kV transmission line to provide N-1 redundancy and strengthen network reliability in the Central Energy System.",
      "evidence": "due to the lack of redundancy of the power system, with only a single 110kV corridor in many parts of the system"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Heavy reliance on electricity imports from Russia exposes Mongolia to cross-border supply vulnerabilities and energy security risks.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Expand domestic transmission network capacity to evacuate local renewable energy and reduce import dependency.",
      "evidence": "domestic generation was falling short of demand and Mongolia’s dependency on Russian imports reached almost 20 percent in 2022."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Complex Treasury fund-flow processes involving MNT investment sub-accounts create potential disbursement bottlenecks and payment delays.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Finalize a clear Financial Management Manual, operate a segregated Designated Account, and streamline Treasury disbursement review procedures.",
      "evidence": "Delays and bottlenecks in the project funds flow arrangements that got complicated with the addition of an investment project account within the Treasury"
    }
  ]
}
